name: Treasury Register
one_liner: Treasury management for corporate treasurers — deposit planner + FX exposure & hedging, gated by a deterministic six-check control engine, narrated by policy-aware AI.
product_pillars: one surface, one URL, one panel at a time
every path into the book runs the same six-check gate
every figure is sourced or editable
current_stage: advanced prototype; publicly hosted for demos; not yet multi-tenant, not yet SOC2, not yet transactable

delivery_targets.future: Azure Marketplace (parked until IT/DevOps bandwidth available)

ai.posture: optional — every AI path has a deterministic fallback

infra.process_manager: manual (three PowerShell windows) — service install planned via NSSM

environment_variables.SEED_FX_DEMO: set to 1 to include FX exposures + hedge deals in the seed
environment_variables.TREASURY_MODEL_API_KEY: Groq API key; empty = deterministic fallbacks only
environment_variables.TREASURY_API_ORIGIN: frontend uses this as the backend upstream for /api/* rewrites (default http://127.0.0.1:8001 mock)
